description: Institutional DG Generator 2026 source: monthly electricity generation in kWh for May - Jul 2026, supplied and approved for import by the project owner on 2026-10-01. Generation (kWh) is the governed DG source activity from 2026-05-01 (0015_dg_kwh_methodology). Diesel litres and emissions are not source data: the backend derives litres with the governed DG_SFC and calculates emissions with the governed DIESEL factor. August 2026 is not part of this source; it has not been approved for import.
